svg.title: What is gRPC? — ByteByteGo infographic
svg.desc: Editable recreation of ByteByteGo's infographic. The top compares local calls and remote procedure calls, shows an illustrative Protocol Buffers contract, and lists use cases. The lower left follows steps 1 to 13 from an Order Service client through encoding, the gRPC runtime, HTTP/2, and a Payment Service server, then back. The lower right preserves the source's qualitative pros and cons. The accompanying card explains the source's terminology typo, incomplete proto example, and omitted reverse transport arrow.
svg.text: How do we transmit data via gRPC?
